system.description:
You generate an Earthen Artifact in the form of some tusked or horned creature of your description and manipulate it to ram into a target creature of your choice within range.

Make a melee Ninjutsu Attack against a target creature within range, as the Earthen Artifact attempts to ram the target. On a hit, you deal 3d10 Piercing damage and 3d10 Earth damage.

Once this jutsu ends, the Earthen Artifact stands in place occupying a 5-foot cube. The construct weighs 500 pounds, and can be used as partial cover. It counts as an Earthen Artifact of your creation while remaining as a part of the environment until destroyed or otherwise moved.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above B-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the number of Earthen Artifacts you summon. Each Earthen Artifact must target a different creature.
